Blemish borrows clean skin from just bes: Blemish borrows clean skin from just beside the mark; red-eye drains the red and keeps the catchlight.
Clarity is midtone contrast and is held: Clarity is midtone contrast and is held back in the brightest and darkest areas, where it would only make halos and noise.
Each brush keeps its own painted area, s: Each brush keeps its own painted area, so lightening a face and darkening a background do not fight over the same pixels.
Highlights and Shadows each hold one end: Highlights and Shadows each hold one end of the range, so recovering a bright sky will not flatten the shadows.
Only your skin selection is affected, an: Only your skin selection is affected, and nothing is lightened automatically.
Straightening trims the edges that rotat: Straightening trims the edges that rotate out of frame, so the picture stays rectangular.
Vibrance lifts muted colour and leaves c: Vibrance lifts muted colour and leaves colour that is already strong alone, which is what keeps skin from going orange.
